pca9685_50hz_mapping.calculation_note: At 50Hz, one PCA9685 count is about 4.88us. 500us maps to ~102, 1500us maps to ~307, 2500us maps to ~512.

training_lesson: Do not use broad PCA9685 exploratory ranges for a known servo. Convert the servo's published microsecond pulse range to raw PCA counts and constrain UI/firmware defaults before movement testing.
